question: Should this session-state scheduling change land after the contributor supplies inspectable real Control UI proof for rapid switching and same-client reconnect behavior on the refreshed head?
rationale: The patch changes ordering across several per-session UI surfaces, and the protected `maintainer` label plus absent inspectable live proof make this a human merge decision rather than an automated repair decision.

options.title: Request live UI proof
options.body: Require a redacted recording, runtime trace, or terminal-backed demonstration showing transcript-first rendering and correct deferred panels across rapid session changes and reconnects.

options.title: Accept mock-only evidence
options.body: Land based on the focused regression tests and reported Testbox run while accepting the remaining browser-lifecycle uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Request live UI proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted recording, runtime trace, or terminal-backed demonstration showing transcript-first rendering and correct deferred panels across rapid session changes and reconnects.

likelyOwner.reason: The visible commit history associates this contributor with the proposed hydration ordering and its regression tests; current-main ownership evidence was unavailable.
